inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Stoneveil, a vast cave where a tribe of blood priests holds its rites, lit by glowing red crystals and torches, where everything down here wants your blood. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. A section of one wide connected region panorama, refined with crisp pixel clusters.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn battle stage with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth", "lighting": "Warm torchlight and glowing red crystals from the upper left, cool teal bounce light, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the cave floor in calm even light, bright and readable, never murky.", "color_palette": ["#1c1426", "#3a2240", "#5a2a4a", "#8a2a3a", "#d23a4a", "#ff6a6a", "#f2a24a", "#ffd27a", "#2a6a6a", "#4ab0a0", "#7a6a8a", "#a89ab0", "#e8dcd0", "#8a94a8", "#6e7890"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "A section of a continuous 2.5D battle stage panorama seen from a fixed side oblique camera, no people: sky above a distant horizon, scenery behind the arena in overlapping rows, a calm empty floor.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 300, 1000], "desc": "the high dark ceiling of a vast cavern, hung with long red crystal stalactites glowing softly"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [540, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "one calm, empty, smooth mid grey blue stone cave floor running the whole width, lit evenly, a worn path along its back edge through all three places"}]}}
